messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "turn dose knob all the way until it stops"
set: ["turn dose knob all the way until it stops", "continue holding until the yellow plunger rod stops moving and fills the viewing window", "wait until your next scheduled dose", "take the missed dose if it is within 4 days after the missed dose", "may be taken with or without food, but take it the same way each time", "keep until the expiration date printed on the label", "If you have missed the dose for the whole day, skip it", "skip the missed dose if it is almost time for your next dose", "do not drive until you know how it affects you", "take same way each day", "place the tablet(s) under your tongue until dissolved", "swallow all of the mixture right away", "If it is almost time for your next dose, wait until then to take the medicine", "skip it if it is almost time for your next dose", "drink all of the mixture right away", "lower the dose gradually"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
